description: Evaluate ONLY the supplied state with a separately configured decision model. Ask boolean (explicit answer and/or probability_true), choice (competing alternatives), or score (0-1 rubric position) questions. The decision model sees nothing but the state and questions you pass — no conversation, files, or memory. It abstains where the evidence is missing, and a missing probability is never inferred. Advisory only: results never authorize actions. Requires decisionModel in config.yaml.
name: decision_evaluate

criteria.description: Optional judging criteria: for boolean, {"true": ..., "false": ...}; for choice, one entry per option; for score, an ordered rubric list.

id.description: Stable id for this question, echoed in the answers.

options.description: Required for choice: the competing alternatives.

question.description: The question, judged only against state.

type.description: boolean: true/false + probability_true. choice: pick one listed option. score: 0-1 rubric position.

state.description: The only evidence the decision model sees: a claim, a JSON object, or a list. Keep it to the evidence the questions need.
